explication: This repository patches Audi MHI2Q CarPlay to add Virtual Cockpit and HUD route guidance, cluster cover art, touchpad-to-DPAD input, and parking-popup coexistence. The primary workflow carries iPhone route guidance through the native hook and Java integration to BAP cluster updates and a separate maneuver renderer, while preserving the stock map. The graph also shows display composition and the independent media, input, and parking features. Some source excerpts are partial; uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
